notes.title: Difficulty levels
notes.notes:
With Cassiodora we wanted to create a game accessible to all players. In addition to the standard difficulty levels (easy, normal, hard), we will have an accessibility level available where the player will be able to enjoy the game without worrying about the punishment for making mistakes, regardless of their age or familiarity with games. On the other hand, the game can be quite challenging for those willing to face the challenge.

4 difficulty levels:

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/cd4dd62c7bf84fc1af17c176cebb36a7a5f3dbbf.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Apprentice
[/list] This is an accessibility level, not punitive, even if you die the game does not give you a game over, you can just keep playing without having to worry about that. This is indicated to new players or younger kids.

[list]
[*] Squire
[/list] This is the Easy mode, you have more health, you can find health crystals during the levels to restore you lost crystals and the bosses have less health. Your health is also restored between some Bosses phases.

[list]
[*] Warrior
[/list] This is the Normal mode, you have the standard amount of health and a good challenge on fights and puzzles. You also restore health between some Bosses phases.

[list]
[*] Knight
[/list] This is the Hard mode, you have the standard amount of health but bosses have more health and challenges are much harder. You don't restore health between Bosses phases.

As you can see Cassiodora is a game that you will let you play and have fun with your friends and family whatever their skills!

notes.notes:
Earlier this year we saw that you could customize your characters' outfit and skills.
Today we are going to check out how that customization impact your playstyle!

For example, here Player 1 is using homing missiles which track foes whereas Player 2 is using arrow that goes straightforward until it mets its foe.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/54b527fea9a6dc0b037fde45c9d0030f4d4518e7.gif[/img]

But in Cassiodora you can switch at any time between 2 different skills! Later during the same stage those player switched skills with boomerang projectiles and multiples shots, see how it goes!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/f8b287ba7ae9e8088bf249da315dc2bf3786b246.gif[/img]

The range and behavior of projectiles depends on the skills you took before your mission. Be sure to take your skills according to the situation and what your friends brought with them to take on every threat you'll face with ease.

notes.title: A unique medieval fantasy Shoot'em up
notes.notes:
Cassiodora is a medieval fantasy Shoot'em up based on elemental powers playable with up to 2 friends. Today we will showcase you how those elemental powers works against monster in Cassiodora.   

You can use 3 different elemental powers: lightning, fire and ice. Each one of them is useful depending on the situation you're facing whether it is monster and bosses or even locks and chests to open.      

Your adventure will start at the nearby forest where the Whomping Oak awaits. He is a powerful being but he still is a tree. Set him on fire to defeat him!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/1248bfca7ad5859b22fe1a6fc5386c4bf350fa5c.gif[/img]

The graveyard is a dangerous place and you might face a dangerous spider there... He can protect himself from your shots with an armor, how about you shoot some electric shots to counter it?

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/d0369823e5f402563d42fa29bf01e3bf72619d7b.gif[/img]

Switch between the elements to finally defeat him!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/7250f347a7d34490e0f812ba3e4d0b1fd386a519.gif[/img]

If you're playing solo you will have all the elemental powers at your disposal. But if you're playing with friends you will have to communicate between yourselves as each person will have a different elemental power to use.
